rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Go-based filesystem server with enterprise security features including role-based access control using CEL expressions, JWT-based authentication with OAuth2 integration, and a comprehensive undo system for file operations. Supports both stdio and HTTP transports, offers process management for background command execution, scratch storage, and system information retrieval. Designed for development workflows and system administration tasks requiring fine-grained permission control over file operations.
